purpose: Additional untouched-by-SARscope historical evaluation after training-only sampling sensitivity gates; not blinded prospective validation
data_license: Upstream CC BY-SA 4.0; fetched source structures not redistributed

datasets.name: ATA
datasets.family: phenotypic anti-tuberculosis assay; not a defined protein target family
datasets.endpoint: deposited anti-tuberculosis log activity; no invented pIC50 conversion or assay-homogeneity assertion

source_notes: No SARscope ATA model/prediction scores were inspected before freezing. Source file metadata had been audited; published historical outcomes are known, so this is not a blinded challenge. ACE/THERM were not silently deduplicated to manufacture more clean validation cohorts. No fresh data are used to choose a new preset after this run.

interpretation.scope: Reviewed pre-aligned explicit-H SDF, five documented atom-centred Gaussian fields; no claim for generated conformers or CoMFA
interpretation.selection: Candidate was prespecified before sensitivity runs on numerical-method grounds. Sampling-phase gates passed on three training-only cohorts. Pose sensitivity failures remain warnings, not silently removed cases. Candidate is not the highest-q2 winner or the winner on old external R2.
interpretation.model_qualification: Use all existing per-model checks. Numerical sampling stability does not establish a correct binding mode or useful external predictions.
interpretation.no_claim: This one additional phenotypic cohort cannot establish general multi-family predictive superiority or full-package validation. No test-label correction, outlier exclusion or test-driven retuning. CoMFA remains experimental.
